sonnet.problem: Card 2 already asks what the heavens declare in Psalm 19:1. Card 3 then asks about the parallel line in the same verse (the skies proclaim the work of His hands). The two lines make the same point, so they should have been one question.
sonnet.rule: Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply the word "simple" from Psalm 19:7. Nothing earlier on the cards lets a baker reason to that word, so this is a wording guess in a psalm. The answers "proud" and "mighty" are not reasoned out either.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
